definitions.gloss: bottom of a valley; valley floor
definitions.explanation: The lowest point of a valley. Also used figuratively to mean the lowest point of a situation, such as an economic depression.

examples.japanese: {谷底|たにそこ}に{川|かわ}が{流|なが}れている。
examples.english: A river flows at the bottom of the valley.

examples.japanese: {車|くるま}が{崖|がけ}から{谷底|たにそこ}に{転落|てんらく}した。
examples.english: A car fell from the cliff to the bottom of the valley.

examples.japanese: {景気|けいき}が{谷底|たにそこ}から{回復|かいふく}し{始|はじ}めたという{報道|ほうどう}に、{市場|しじょう}は{好感|こうかん}を{示|しめ}した。
examples.english: The market reacted favorably to reports that the economy had begun to recover from its lowest point.

notes:
{谷底|たにそこ} is a compound of {谷|たに} (valley) and {底|そこ} (bottom). It refers to the lowest point of a valley.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {谷底|たにそこ}に{落|お}ちる (fall to the bottom of a valley)
- {谷底|たにそこ}に{転落|てんらく}する (plunge into the valley)
- {景気|けいき}の{谷底|たにそこ} (the trough of the economy)

The word is also used figuratively to describe the lowest point of an economic cycle or personal hardship. In economic contexts, {谷底|たにそこ} is the opposite of {山頂|さんちょう} or ピーク (peak).
